augments.desc_zh: 對友軍使用時，你的治療和護盾效果提升。

augments.desc_en: Casting a spell refunds another random spell's cost by [value]% of the original spell's Cooldown.
augments.desc_zh: 施放技能時，會返還另一個隨機技能的費用，數值為原始技能冷卻時間的[value]%。

augments.desc_en: Gain increased Ability Damage, Healing, Shielding, and Ability Haste, but you cannot use your Ultimate Ability.
augments.desc_zh: 增加技能傷害、治療、護盾，並獲得技能加速，但無法使用大絕。

augments.desc_en: QUEST: Snipe [value] enemy champions with abilities REWARD: Send a meteor at Sniped enemy champions, dealing Magic damage in an area around them
augments.desc_zh: 任務：用技能狙擊[value]名敵方英雄 獎勵：召喚隕石砸向你狙擊的敵方英雄，對其周圍區域造成魔法傷害

augments.desc_zh: 每有 [value]魔攻增加[value]護盾。在死亡或護盾耗盡後70秒重置。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Health, but you deal [value]% less damage.
augments.desc_zh: 增加[value]生命，但造成的傷害降低[value]%。

augments.desc_zh: 施展治療和生命回復時，也會對最靠近的敵方英雄造成魔法傷害。

augments.desc_en: Gain Deceive Summoner Spell. Gain Backstab Passive. When you die, deal a large amount of true damage and Fear nearby enemies.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得召喚師技能欺詐魔術。 獲得被動技能背刺。 陣亡時，對鄰近敵軍造成大量真實傷害及恐懼效果。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Shield after Immobilizing or Grounding an enemy champion.
augments.desc_zh: 在硬控場或禁錮敵方英雄後獲得[value]護盾。

augments.desc_en: Your healing and Shields can Critically Strike for [value]% bonus amount. Gain [value]% Crit Chance.
augments.desc_zh: 你的治療與護盾可以暴擊，治療量或護盾量提升[value]%。增加 [value]%暴擊率。

augments.desc_en: On Immobilizing or Grounding a champion, summon a comet that lands after a delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.
augments.desc_zh: 硬控場或禁錮英雄時，召喚一顆於短暫延遲後墜落的彗星，對鄰近敵軍造成魔法傷害。

augments.desc_en: Your dash, leap, blink, or teleport Abilities gain [value] Ability Haste.
augments.desc_zh: 衝刺、跳躍、閃現或傳送技能獲得[value]技能加速。

augments.desc_en: When dropping below [value]% Health, heal for [value]% max Health over 3 seconds. Resets on death or every [value] seconds.
augments.desc_zh: 生命低於[value]%時，在3秒內回復[value]%最大生命。 每[value]秒或死亡時重置。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value]% Attack Speed.
augments.desc_zh: 增加 [value]%攻速。

augments.desc_zh: 死亡時爆炸，造成大量真實傷害。

augments.desc_en: On takedown, enemy champions leave behind their Essence. Attacking the Essence grants movement speed and resets basic ability cooldowns.
augments.desc_zh: 參與擊殺時，敵方英雄會留下精華。攻擊精華會獲得跑速，並重置基礎技能冷卻時間。

augments.desc_en: Every [value] seconds, Autocast a protective star. Upon its landing, you and nearby allies become Invulnerable for a few seconds.
augments.desc_zh: 每[value]秒自動施放一顆守護星。守護星落地時，你和附近的友軍獲得幾秒鐘的無敵狀態。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value]% bonus damage per 10 Move Speed you have more than the target.
augments.desc_zh: 每高出目標10跑速，傷害便增加[value]%。

augments.desc_en: Your Critical Strikes apply On-Hit effects an additional time. Gain [value] Crit chance.
augments.desc_zh: 暴擊額外施加一次命中效果。 增加 [value]%暴擊率。

augments.desc_en: Become melee and gain Attack Damage, Health, Attack Speed, Lifesteal, and Movement Speed (scaling with the range you give up).
augments.desc_zh: 變為近戰並增加物攻、生命、攻速、吸血以及跑速(成長幅度取決於你犧牲的距離)。

augments.desc_en: On death, a giant Tibbers with all your augments falls from the sky and damages nearby enemies.
augments.desc_zh: 死亡時，一隻擁有你所有增幅裝置的巨型泰貝爾會從天而降，對鄰近敵軍造成傷害。

augments.desc_en: Your Attacks and Abilities execute low Health enemy champions, Knocking Back and causing an explosion while healing you.
augments.desc_zh: 普攻和技能會處決低生命的敵方英雄、造成擊退並引發爆炸，同時回復自身生命。

augments.desc_en: Attacks fire a bolt that applies 命中效果 effects at reduced strength. Gain [value]% total Attack Speed.
augments.desc_zh: 普攻會射出一道箭矢，施加命中效果但威力減弱。增加[value]%總攻速。

augments.desc_en: Your dash, blink, or teleport Abilities leave behind a trail that detonates after [value] second.
augments.desc_zh: 施放衝刺、閃現或傳送技能後會留下軌跡，軌跡會在[value]秒後引爆。

augments.desc_en: Healing or Shielding allies blesses them, causing their damage to fill you with devotion. When you have enough devotion, unleash a shockwave dealing magic damage and executes low health enemies.
augments.desc_zh: 給予友軍治療或護盾時會祝福對方；他們對敵軍造成傷害時，你會獲得信仰。 累積足夠信仰時，便會發出衝擊波，造成魔法傷害並處決低生命的敵軍。

augments.desc_en: Periodically identify Vitals on enemy champions. Hitting them with Attacks or Abilities deals max Health true damage, restores Health, and grants Movement Speed. These effects can stack.
augments.desc_zh: 定期找出敵方英雄的破綻。用普攻或技能擊中破綻時，造成最大生命的真實傷害、回復自身生命並增加跑速。這些效果可累加。

augments.desc_en: Damaging enemies adds a stacking Armor and Magic Resist shred for [value]s.
augments.desc_zh: 對敵軍造成傷害可累加一層物理與魔法防禦削弱，持續[value]秒。

augments.desc_en: Your Abilities apply 命中效果 effects. 1 second Cooldown per target.
augments.desc_zh: 技能會施加命中效果。對每個目標有1秒冷卻時間。

augments.desc_en: Gain Ability Haste equal to [value]% Ability Power.
augments.desc_zh: 增加相當於[value]%魔攻的技能加速。

augments.desc_en: Attacks against enemy champions fire [value] missiles that deal more damage with distance. Each direction has its own Cooldown.
augments.desc_zh: 對敵方英雄普攻時，發射[value]枚飛彈，傷害量隨飛行距離增加。每個方向的冷卻時間各不相同。

augments.desc_en: Damaging with your Ultimate Polymorphs enemies for a few seconds.

augments.desc_en: Your Attacks apply an infinitely stacking Burn 命中效果, dealing damage over time.

augments.desc_en: Autocast Gain Movement Speed and conjure three flames that orbit you, targetting the closest visible enemy in range and dealing magic damage.
augments.desc_zh: 自動施放 獲得跑速並召喚三團環繞你的火焰，指定最靠近的可見敵軍並造成魔法傷害。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value]% Heal and Shield Power.
augments.desc_zh: 增加[value]%治療與護盾強度。

augments.desc_en: Your Flash has [value] charges. After [value] seconds, regain all charges.
augments.desc_zh: 你可以使用[value]次閃現。[value]秒後，恢復所有使用次數。

augments.desc_en: Gain the First Strike and Dark Harvest Keystone Runes.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得先發制人及靈魂收割關鍵符文。

augments.desc_en: Increase Movement Speed and Attack Speed for [value] seconds on takedown.

augments.desc_en: Nearby enemies have a chance to drop Stat Anvils on death.
augments.desc_zh: 鄰近敵軍在死亡時有機會掉落能力值鐵砧。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value]% Movement Speed, disabled for [value] seconds after taking damage.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得[value]%跑速，受到傷害後失效[value]秒。

augments.desc_en: Gain the Aftershock and Glacial Augment Keystone Runes.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得裂地衝擊與冰川增幅關鍵符文。

augments.desc_en: You gain the Infernal Dragon Soul, dealing bonus damage when you hit enemies with Abilities or Attacks.

augments.desc_en: On each Revive, you grow large (gaining Adaptive Force and Health) or tiny (gaining Ability Haste and Movement Speed).
augments.desc_zh: 每次復活時，體型變大(增加適性之力及生命)或變小(增加技能加速及跑速)。

augments.desc_en: You gain the Mountain Soul, gaining a Shield after being out of combat for a short time.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得裂地龍魂，脫離戰鬥一段時間後可獲得一道護盾。

augments.desc_en: Autocast throw a boomerang at a nearby enemy every [value]s.
augments.desc_zh: 每[value]秒自動施放對鄰近敵軍發射回力鏢。

augments.desc_zh: 將所有的增幅裝置物轉化為隨機稜鏡增幅裝置。

augments.desc_zh: 根據額外物防和魔防，增加[value]%治療量和護盾量。

augments.desc_zh: 冷卻時間減免一定百分比，並將所有攻速轉換為技能加速。

augments.desc_zh: 定期自動施放一次大範圍斬擊。敵軍遭命中時會緩速，額外承受最大生命傷害，並讓你回復生命。

augments.desc_zh: 任務：參與擊殺[value]次。 獎勵：黃金鍋鏟。

augments.desc_en: Heal for [value]% of damage done by Critical Strikes. Gain [value]% Crit chance.

augments.desc_en: Your spin Abilities gain [value] Ability Haste and deal [value] more damage, increase to [value] for Ultimates

augments.desc_en: On takedown, creates an explosion that slows other nearby enemies by [value]%, and deals damage based on their current Health.
augments.desc_zh: 參與擊殺時會產生爆炸，使鄰近敵軍緩速[value]%，並根據其當前生命造成傷害。

augments.desc_en: When you gain permanent Stacks of an Ability, gain [value]% more!

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Stat Anvils!
augments.desc_zh: 獲得[value]塊能力值鐵砧！

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils!
augments.desc_zh: 獲得[value]個能力值鐵砧，並有較高機會是黃金或稜鏡鐵砧！

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils! On your next Augment selection, gain one additional reroll per slot.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得[value]個能力值鐵砧，並有較高機會是黃金或稜鏡鐵砧！ 下次選擇增幅裝置時，每個欄位可額外重抽一次。

augments.desc_en: Using your Ultimate Taunts nearby enemies and grants you damage reduction. Gain [value] Ultimate Ability Haste.
augments.desc_zh: 施放大絕後，嘲諷鄰近敵軍並賦予自身傷害減免。 獲得[value]大絕技能加速。

augments.desc_en: Damaging enemy champions with [技能] heals you.
augments.desc_zh: 以[技能]對敵方英雄造成傷害時，會治療自身。

augments.desc_en: Gain the Lethal Tempo and Conqueror Keystone Runes.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得致命節奏與征服者關鍵符文。

augments.desc_en: On takedown, gain a stack that increases your size and max Health. Lose stacks on death.
augments.desc_zh: 參與擊殺時獲得一層堆層，可增加體型和最大生命。死亡時失去層數。

augments.desc_en: You can Critically Defend using your Crit Chance (max [value]% chance), giving you a chance to reduce damage. Gain [value]% Crit Chance.
augments.desc_zh: 可根據自身暴擊率進行完美防禦(上限為[value]%機率)，觸發時減少承受的傷害。 增加 [value]%暴擊率。

augments.desc_en: Your Attacks grant you Movement Speed. Gain Attack Speed based on your Movement Speed.
augments.desc_zh: 普攻可增加跑速。根據跑速獲得攻速。

augments.desc_en: Whenever you cast [技能], Fear enemies around you.
augments.desc_zh: 施放[技能]時，使周圍敵軍陷入恐懼。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value]% Armor Penetration and Magic Penetration.

augments.desc_zh: 獲得[value]件隨機增幅裝置。

augments.desc_en: Gain a random Prismatic Augment.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得一件隨機稜鏡增幅裝置。

augments.desc_zh: 施放大絕後重置其冷卻時間(冷卻時間[value]秒，或在死亡時重置)。

augments.desc_zh: 以蒐集者的被動效果處決敵軍時，會提升處決門檻並獲得額外金錢。 獲得250金錢。

augments.desc_en: Gain 500 Gold. Having Infinity Edge allows your Critical Strike Chance to grant random Critical Strike Damage each Attack.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得500金錢。 持有無盡之刃時，你的暴擊會根據暴擊率造成隨機額外暴擊傷害。

augments.desc_en: Hollow Radiance and Sunfire Aegis grant [value] Gold per target affected with Immolate. Gain 250 Gold.
augments.desc_zh: 每有一名受獻祭影響的目標，虛偽光彩和日炎聖盾賦予[value]金錢。獲得250金錢。

augments.desc_en: Your Spellblade effects deal additional damage and heal you for a percent of the target's health. Additionally, gain 250 Gold.
augments.desc_zh: 魔法彎刀的效果會造成額外傷害，並依目標生命的一定比例治療你。此外，可獲得250金錢。

augments.desc_en: Reduce Zhonya's Hourglass Cooldown to [value] seconds. You can now move and gain Movement Speed when in Zhonya's Hourglass, Seeker's Armguard, or Wooglet's Witchcap stasis. Gain 250 Gold.
augments.desc_zh: 將中婭沙漏的冷卻時間縮短至[value]秒。你現在處於中婭沙漏、探索者護腕或烏莉特的法帽的凝滯狀態時可以移動且增加跑速。 獲得250金錢。

augments.desc_en: Your Item and damage over time effects can Critically Strike. Gain [value]% Crit chance.
augments.desc_zh: 道具與持續傷害效果可以暴擊。 增加 [value]%暴擊率。

augments.desc_en: When moving towards allies with low Health, gain Movement Speed. Your Healing and Shielding are greater based on how low your target's Health is.
augments.desc_zh: 當你朝生命較低的友軍移動時，會獲得跑速。目標生命越低，你的治療和護盾效果越強。

augments.desc_en: Your Healing and Shielding also increases the target's Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds.
augments.desc_zh: 治療與護盾效果同時會增加目標的物理防禦與魔法防禦3秒。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Ability Power.
augments.desc_zh: 增加 [value]魔攻。

augments.desc_en: Gain Move Speed equal to [value]% of your Ability Haste.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得等同於技能加速[value]%的跑速。

augments.desc_en: On takedown, enemy champions drop coins nearby, which you and your allies can collect. Each is worth [value] gold.
augments.desc_zh: 參與擊殺敵方英雄時，敵方英雄會在附近掉落金幣，供你和隊友撿取。每枚金幣值[value]金錢。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Critical Strike Chance and [value] Attack Speed.
augments.desc_zh: 增加[value]暴擊率和[value]攻速。

augments.desc_en: Convert Ability Power to Bonus Attack Damage. Gain [value]% Attack Damage.
augments.desc_zh: 將魔攻轉換為額外物攻。增加[value]%物攻。

augments.desc_en: Casting your [技能] sends a clone toward your mouse position and recasts it.
augments.desc_zh: 施放[技能]時會朝滑鼠位置製造一個分身，並重施技能。

augments.desc_en: Each time you Immobilize or Ground an enemy, gain Armor and Magic Resist.
augments.desc_zh: 每次硬控場或禁錮敵軍時，增加物防和魔防。

augments.name_en: I'm a Baby Kitty Where is Mama
augments.name_zh: 我是小貓咪媽咪在哪裡

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Ability Haste on Snowball. Your snowball is BIG and will pass through minions. It Slows, Knocks Up champions, and deals additional damage. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.
augments.desc_zh: 雪球增加[value]技能加速。 你的雪球超大且會穿過士兵。雪球會緩速、擊飛英雄並造成額外傷害。 若你沒有雪球就會獲得一顆雪球。

augments.desc_en: Burn and damage-over-time on champions generate gold.
augments.desc_zh: 對英雄造成的燃燒和持續傷害效果會產生金錢。

augments.desc_zh: 進入草叢後，可造成額外[value]%傷害，持續[value]秒。待在草叢中可重置效果。

augments.desc_zh: 暴擊敵軍會掉落牙齒。撿起牙齒會永久獲得物理致命和魔法穿透。

augments.desc_en: If a target Knocked Back by [技能] hits another champion, they are Knocked Up and dealt damage. When colliding with terrain, the Knock Up duration is extended and they are dealt bonus damage.
augments.desc_zh: 如果目標被「[技能]」擊退時撞到另一位英雄，該英雄會被擊飛並受到傷害。如果撞擊地形，則延長擊飛時間並造成額外傷害。

augments.desc_en: Gain Ability Haste equal to [value]% of your Critical Strike Chance.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得自身[value]%暴擊率的技能加速。

augments.desc_en: When you Critically Strike, fire missiles dealing magic damage. Gain [value]% Crit chance.
augments.desc_zh: 暴擊時，會發射飛彈，造成魔法傷害。 增加 [value]%暴擊率。

augments.desc_en: Gain the When the Darkness Comes Summoner Spell. Create a zone that transports everyone inside of it to another dimension.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得召喚師技能「黑暗時刻」。創造一個區域，將其中所有人傳送到另一個次元。

augments.desc_en: Get [value] Gold. No questions asked.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得[value]金錢。別問那麼多。

augments.desc_en: Gain a Shield for every second you spend Channeling.
augments.desc_zh: 每詠唱1秒，獲得1層護盾。

augments.desc_en: Shields granted from [技能] are stronger and scaling with target's missing Health.
augments.desc_zh: 「[技能]」賦予的護盾量增強，且會隨目標的已損失生命而提升。

augments.desc_en: [技能] applies 命中效果 effects an additional time.
augments.desc_zh: [技能]會額外觸發一次命中效果。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value]% Heal and Shield power. Gain Empyrean Promise as a Summoner Spell. Vigilance Teleport to an ally and grant [value] Shield for [value] seconds after landing.
augments.desc_zh: 增加 [value]%治療量和護盾量。獲得幻焰之誓召喚師技能。 全神貫注 傳送到友軍身旁，抵達時獲得[value]護盾，持續[value]秒。

augments.desc_zh: 達到[value]%生命時，獲得大量逐漸衰減的護盾、逐漸衰減的跑速，以及逐漸恢復的縮小效果。

augments.desc_en: After casting your Ultimate, gain a max Health Shield, Omnivamp and Movement Speed for [value] seconds.
augments.desc_zh: 施放大絕後，獲得最大生命護盾、全能吸血以及跑速，持續[value]秒。

augments.desc_zh: 死亡後幾秒內，鯊魚會撕咬所有鄰近敵軍。你在死亡後可以透過移動瞄準鯊魚攻擊。

augments.desc_en: Gain a second Flash Summoner Spell and [value] Summoner Haste.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得第二次閃現召喚師技能和[value]召喚師技能加速。

augments.desc_en: Increase your Item and Augment damage by [value].
augments.desc_zh: 道具與增幅裝置的傷害提升[value]。

augments.desc_en: Reduce max Health by [value]%. Deal an extra [value] damage as true damage.
augments.desc_zh: 最大生命減少[value]%。造成額外[value]真實傷害。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Ability Haste on Snowball. You are briefly Invulnerable when you dash with Snowball. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.
augments.desc_zh: 雪球增加[value]技能加速。 使用雪球衝刺時，短暫進入無敵狀態。 若你沒有雪球就會獲得一顆雪球。

augments.desc_en: Damaging a champion with Attacks or Abilities deals additional magic damage, and grants you Gold and Movement Speed.
augments.desc_zh: 以普攻或技能傷害英雄時，造成額外魔法傷害，並獲得金錢和跑速。

augments.desc_en: Gain Growth Spurt as a Summoner Spell. Growth Spurt suddenly increases your size, Knocking Up nearby enemies and granting max Health.

augments.desc_en: Gain [value]% Adaptive Force. Nearby allied minions are greatly empowered.
augments.desc_zh: 增加[value]%適性之力。大幅強化鄰近友軍士兵。

augments.desc_zh: 每過一段時間，下一次傷害性技能或普攻會對附近敵人觸發連鎖的閃電炸裂，造成傷害與緩速。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Ability Haste, plus [value] Ability Haste per takedown.
augments.desc_zh: 增加[value]技能加速，每次參與擊殺則額外增加[value]技能加速。

augments.desc_en: Activating [技能] grants you Movement Speed for its duration.
augments.desc_zh: 發動[技能]會在持續期間賦予自身跑速。

augments.desc_zh: 施放[技能]期間，普攻命中效果會縮短該技能冷卻時間。

augments.desc_en: Gain increased Movement Speed towards enemies at low Health.
augments.desc_zh: 跑向低生命敵軍時，增加跑速。

augments.desc_en: The first time you take the enemy transport with a Legendary Item you become Kinged, upgrading your item and gaining a random Prismatic Augment.
augments.desc_zh: 首次攜帶傳說道具乘坐敵方傳送門後，你將加冕為王、升級道具，並獲得一件隨機稜鏡增幅裝置。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Attack Range and [value] Attack Speed during your [技能] duration.
augments.desc_zh: 在「[技能]」持續期間增加[value]攻擊距離和[value]攻速。

augments.desc_en: After healing or shielding your ally with [技能], your next basic attack gains attack range, attack speed and deals bonus max Health magic damage.
augments.desc_zh: 使用[技能]治療或給予護盾友軍後，你的下一次普攻將增加攻擊距離和攻速，並造成額外最大生命魔法傷害。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Adaptive Force for [value] seconds when you gain a Shield ([value] seconds Cooldown).
augments.desc_zh: 獲得護盾時，增加[value]適性之力，持續[value]秒(冷卻時間[value]秒)。

augments.desc_en: Your [技能] missile splits into two on hit, at max Range, or when Recast.
augments.desc_zh: 你的「[技能]」飛彈在命中、達到最遠距離或重施技能時會分裂成兩發。

augments.desc_en: Entering Brush regenerates a large amount of Health.
augments.desc_zh: 進入草叢時，治療大量生命。

augments.desc_en: Takedowns against enemy champions within [value] seconds of damaging them grants you Movement Speed and renders you invisible.
augments.desc_zh: 對敵方英雄造成傷害後，在[value]秒內參與擊殺他們，會增加跑速，並讓你進入隱形狀態。

augments.desc_en: Gain Ability Power, Movement Speed, and Omnivamp based on missing Health, taking damage each time you cast.
augments.desc_zh: 根據已損失生命獲得魔攻、跑速和全能吸血，每次施放技能都會受到傷害。

augments.desc_zh: 回城進入你的砲擊發射器。它的射程、砲彈速度和傷害都大幅提升。

augments.desc_zh: 經過友軍身旁時，對方會鼓勵你，賦予你護盾和跑速。

augments.desc_en: Gain Poltergeist as a Summoner Spell. Poltergeist casts both Barrier and Ghost.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得召喚師技能「搗蛋鬼」。 「搗蛋鬼」可施放「光盾」和「鬼步」。

augments.desc_en: QUEST: Gather Poro Snax and feed [value] Poros. REWARD: Gain the Poro Charge Summoner Spell, which launches waves of Poros at the enemy team. Additional waves unlock per Quest Level. "Oho! Look how charming they are!" — Poro Herder
augments.desc_zh: 任務：收集普羅點心並餵食[value]普羅。 獎勵：召喚師技能「普羅衝鋒」——向敵方隊伍發射一波波超可愛又超危險的普羅。任務每升一級，就能發射更多次普羅。 「喔呵！你看看他們多可愛啊！」——普羅牧人

augments.desc_en: Every second, apply a stacking Burn to nearby enemy champions, scaling with your max Health. QUEST: Deal Burn damage to enemy Champions. REWARD: Size and damage increase per Quest Level.
augments.desc_zh: 每秒對鄰近敵方英雄附加一層燃燒，傷害隨你的最大生命成長。 任務：對敵方英雄造成燃燒傷害。 獎勵：任務每升一級，提升體型和傷害。

augments.desc_en: Every [value] seconds, Autocast a sparkly tiara descends upon you. When it lands, gain Rakan's Ultimate, charming enemies you touch.
augments.desc_zh: 每隔[value]秒自動施放，以閃亮寶冠為自己加冕。戴上寶冠時，獲得銳空的大絕，可魅惑觸碰到的敵軍。

augments.desc_en: Immediate: Gain a random pair of upgraded boots. Requirement: Complete its quest to swap for another. Reward: Jarvan I's Boot
augments.desc_zh: 立即：獲得1雙隨機升級版靴子。 條件：完成任務可換另一雙。 獎勵：嘉文一世的靴子

augments.desc_en: Gain a Tiamat when completing a Hydra Item. QUEST: Gain Ravenous Hydra, Profane Hydra and Titanic Hydra. REWARD: Gain Ultra Hydra.
augments.desc_zh: 合成一件九頭蛇道具時，獲得一把海神之斧。 任務：持有狂怒九頭蛇、瀆神九頭蛇和泰坦九頭蛇。 獎勵：獲得究極九頭蛇。

augments.desc_en: Sharks circle your Snowball, slowing and damaging nearby enemies. When your Snowball hits a Champion, they become trapped in a shark storm!
augments.desc_zh: 鯊魚會圍繞你的雪球盤旋，緩速並傷害鄰近敵軍。當你的雪球命中英雄時，對方會被困在鯊魚風暴中！

augments.desc_en: Takedowns makes you smaller and grant Ability Haste and Movement Speed. Lose [value]% stacks on death.
augments.desc_zh: 參與擊殺會使體型變小，並賦予技能加速及跑速。 死亡時失去[value]%堆層。

augments.desc_en: Your Ability Haste only applies to your Ultimate, but is 50% more effective. Gain 100 Ability Haste.
augments.desc_zh: 你的技能加速只能套用於大絕，但效果提升50%。獲得100技能加速。

augments.desc_en: Recast [技能] to explode and return to your original position.
augments.desc_zh: 重施技能「[技能]」會引爆並返回你原本的位置。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Ability Haste on Snowball. Hitting an enemy creates a snowfall that deals AoE damage and Slows nearby enemies. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.
augments.desc_zh: 讓你的雪球獲得[value]技能加速。命中敵軍時會降雪，造成範圍傷害並使鄰近敵軍緩速。 若你沒有雪球就會獲得一顆雪球。

augments.desc_en: Recasting Snowball deals increased damage, Knocks Up the target, and Knocks Back nearby enemies.
augments.desc_zh: 重施雪球會造成更高的傷害，擊飛目標，並擊退鄰近敵軍。

augments.desc_en: Every [value] seconds, automatically cast the Aria of Perseverence and Song of Celerity in an alternating melody. Aria of Perseverence heals nearby allies and grants a temporary shielding aura. Song of Celerity grants a temporary aura that provides bonus Movement Speed.
augments.desc_zh: 每隔[value]秒自動輪替施放堅毅詠嘆調和迅捷奏鳴曲。 堅毅詠嘆調使鄰近友軍回復生命，並暫時獲得護盾靈氣。 迅捷奏鳴曲暫時賦予可增加跑速的靈氣。

augments.desc_en: Immobilizing an enemy champion grants [value] max Health. If taken as your second Augment, starts with [value] Health.
augments.desc_zh: 對敵方英雄造成硬控場後，獲得[value]最大生命。 若這是你拿的第二件增幅裝置，開始時有[value]生命。

augments.desc_en: QUEST: Hit enemy champions with [技能] [value] times. REWARD: Permanently increase [技能] damage.
augments.desc_zh: 任務：以[技能]命中敵方英雄[value]次。 獎勵：永久提升[技能]傷害

augments.desc_en: Your [技能] targets 2 additional enemies in front of you.
augments.desc_zh: 你的「[技能]」會額外鎖定你前方的2名敵軍。

augments.desc_en: Occasionally send out squishy, slappy hands towards all nearby enemy champions, tethering them. Your next attack will pull in all tethered enemies.
augments.desc_zh: 偶爾會向所有鄰近敵方英雄甩出黏呼呼的巴掌，束縛他們。下一次普攻會將所有被束縛的敵軍拉向你。

augments.desc_en: QUEST: Heal allied champions for [value] Health. REWARD: Any healing you provide now also Heals Over Time after the initial heal.
augments.desc_zh: 任務：治療友方英雄[value]生命。 獎勵：你提供的任何治療會在初次治療後持續進行治療。

augments.desc_en: On Ultimate cast, spawn a Zone that grants Ability Haste and Movement Speed. While inside, it fires missiles that deal [value]% of your damage.
augments.desc_zh: 施放大絕時，生成一個區域，為你提供技能加速和跑速。在裡面時，會發射飛彈，造成等同於你[value]%的傷害。

augments.desc_en: Gain a Shield after a Dash or Blink.
augments.desc_zh: 衝刺或閃現後獲得護盾。

augments.desc_en: Your [技能] deals damage in an area around it.
augments.desc_zh: 你的[技能]在其周圍造成範圍傷害。

augments.desc_en: When [技能] damages enemy champions, gain [value] Armor and Magic Resistance.
augments.desc_zh: 「[技能]」對敵方英雄造成傷害時，增加[value]物防和魔防。

augments.desc_en: Striking enemy champions with [技能] forges a bond of Friendship. [技能] gains temporarily increased damage based on your level of Friendship.
augments.desc_zh: 以[技能]命中敵方英雄會締結友誼羈絆。 [技能]會根據你的友誼等級暫時提升傷害。

augments.desc_en: On ability damage, fire 1 plus [value] missiles that deal [value] magic damage each. Gain [value]% Critical Strike Chance.
augments.desc_zh: 造成技能傷害時，發射1+[value]枚飛彈，每一枚造成[value]魔法傷害。 增加 [value]%暴擊率。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Ultimate Ability Haste. After using your Ultimate, refresh your basic abilities and gain [value] basic ability haste for [value]s. ([value]s Cooldown)
augments.desc_zh: 增加[value]大絕加速。 施放大絕後，重置基礎技能並增加[value]基礎技能加速，持續[value]秒(冷卻時間[value]秒)。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value]. Death's Dance's Ignore Pain is increased to [value] of damage received, and heals for more instantly when scoring a takedown.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得 [value]金錢。 死亡之舞的無視痛苦效果提升為所受傷害的[value]，且參與擊殺時立即獲得更多治療。

augments.desc_en: Your spell hits trigger Cleave against enemies. Increase Ravenous Hydra's Life Steal to [value] Gain [value] Gold.
augments.desc_zh: 技能命中時，對敵軍觸發劈砍。狂怒九頭蛇的普攻吸血提升至[value] 獲得[value]金錢。

augments.desc_en: Reduce Sundered Sky's per target cooldown to [value] seconds and heal you for [value] of missing health. Gain [value] Gold.
augments.desc_zh: 突破天際對每個目標的冷卻時間縮短至[value]秒，並治療自身[value]已損失生命。 獲得[value]金錢。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value]% Attack Speed. Increase Sword of Blossoming Dawn's healing to [value]% when you attack enemy champions.
augments.desc_zh: 增加[value]%攻速。 你對敵方英雄進行普攻時，破曉綻放之劍的治療效果提升至[value]%。

augments.desc_en: You cannot be healed by allies or gain Health Regen. Gain [value]% Omnivamp.
augments.desc_zh: 你無法接受友軍治療，也無法獲得生命回復。獲得[value]%全能吸血。

augments.desc_en: Gain a Spell Shield every [value] seconds that blocks the next enemy Ability.
augments.desc_zh: 每[value]秒獲得一道法術護盾，可阻擋下一個敵方技能。

augments.desc_en: Dashing with [技能] spawns a Void Zone that Slows enemy champions and deals magic damage.
augments.desc_zh: 使用「[技能]」衝刺時會生成一個虛空區域，緩速敵方英雄並造成魔法傷害。

augments.desc_en: Striking an enemy champion with [技能] grants you [value] Armor or Magic Resist based on their damage type for [value] seconds. This effect can stack.
augments.desc_zh: 以[技能]擊中敵方英雄時，根據其傷害類型，賦予你[value]物防或魔防，持續[value]秒。此效果可累加。

augments.desc_en: Gain [value] Omnivamp.
augments.desc_zh: 獲得[value]全能吸血。

augments.desc_en: Replace a Summoner Spell with Heroic Swing. Heroic Swing fires a grappling hook, sticking into terrain, after which you can Recast to swing around it. While swinging, automatically Attack the nearest enemy. Colliding with an enemy champion or Recasting ends the swing.
augments.desc_zh: 英勇勾索取代一個召喚師技能。 施放英勇勾索會發射鉤爪嵌入地形，重施技能可以擺蕩繞過地形。擺蕩時會自動普攻最靠近的敵軍。若撞上敵方英雄或重施技能，就會結束擺盪。

augments.name_zh: 獲得一格增幅裝置欄位
獲得1個稜鏡能力值鐵砧

items.description_en: 7% Omnivamp against jungle monsters Sear: Damaging jungle monsters burns them for magic damage over 5 seconds.Challenging Path: Smiting 5 times consumes this item and upgrades your Smite to Challenging Smite, increasing its damage to monsters to 900 and damage to minions to 500 +10% target max Health. Challenging Smite marks champions for 4 seconds. Damaging a marked champion deals an additional true damage to them over 2.5 seconds. You take 10% reduced damage from marked champions.Huntsman: Killing large jungle monsters grants bonus experience.Recoup: Regen up to Mana (based on missing mana) per second when in the jungle or river. Consuming this item grants all item effects permanently and increases Smite damage to monsters. If you have gained more gold from minions than jungle monsters, gold and experience from minions is heavily reduced. Healing is not reduced on AoE attacks. If two levels behind the average champion level of the game, monster kills grant bonus experience. Only attacks and abilities apply Challenging Smite's burn
items.description_zh: 對野怪 7% 全能吸血 灼燒：對野怪造成傷害時會燃燒牠們，在 5 秒內持續造成共 0 魔法傷害。精密之道：重擊 5 次將消耗這個道具並將你的重擊升級為精密重擊，並將重擊對野怪的傷害提升至 900 傷害；對士兵的傷害則提升至 500 + 10% 目標最大生命。精密重擊標記英雄 4 秒。傷害一名被標記的英雄會在 2.5 秒內對其造成 0 真實傷害。你從被標記的英雄身上承受的傷害會減少 10%。狩獵者：擊殺大型野怪會獲得額外經驗值。補償：在野區或河道時，每秒最多回復 0 魔力（根據已損失魔力）。 消耗此道具使你永久獲得所有道具效果，並提升重擊對野怪的傷害。若你從士兵賺取的金錢多過從野怪賺取的金錢，來自士兵的金錢與經驗值將大幅減少。範圍攻擊的治療效果不會減少。如果你的等級比遊戲中英雄的平均等級落後2級，擊殺野怪會獲得額外經驗值。 只有普攻與技能會附加精密重擊的燃燒傷害

items.description_en: Jungle Companions Summon a Scorchclaw that assists you against monsters. The companion grows as you hunt monsters, empowering your Smite. When fully grown, it completes your Jungle Quest and periodically imbues your next Attack or Ability to burn enemies and Slow them. Killing large monsters readies this immediately.
items.description_zh: 野區夥伴 召喚熾爪獵犬協助你對抗野怪。 這位夥伴會在你獵殺野怪的過程中成長，強化你的重擊。當牠成長為完全體，野區任務即完成。牠每過一段時間會強化你的下一次普攻或技能，使敵軍燃燒並對其造成緩速效果。若擊殺大型野怪將立即發動。

items.description_en: Jungle Companions Summon a Gustwalker that assists you against monsters. The companion grows as you hunt monsters, empowering your Smite. When fully grown, it completes your Jungle Quest and grants Move Speed upon entering brush, increased when killing large monsters.
items.description_zh: 野區夥伴 召喚馭風靈狐協助你對抗野怪。 這位夥伴會在你獵殺野怪的過程中成長，強化你的重擊。成長為完成體時，野區任務即完成。牠會增加進入草叢時的跑速，擊殺大型野怪時還會再提升。

items.description_en: Jungle Companions Summon a Mosstomper that assists you against monsters. The companion grows as you hunt monsters, empowering your Smite. When fully grown, it completes your Jungle Quest and grants a Shield while out of combat and after killing large monsters.

items.description_en: Active - Consume: Serves a scrumptious scoop to a nearby Poro, causing it to grow in size. This savory blend of Avarosan hen and local Freljordian herbs—picked daily and flash-frozen—contains the essential nutrients necessary to keep your Poro cool and calm. All proceeds will be donated towards preserving the habitat of the endangered Spotted Poro.
